table_metadata.table_title: Table 4. Schedule of Activities for Early Termination, Unscheduled Visits, and Post-Treatment Follow-Up Period
table_metadata.table_purpose: Procedures at an early termination visit (ETV) and at unscheduled visits (V997), plus the post-treatment follow-up visits V801 and V802, for participants leaving any of the study's three main timelines.
table_metadata.notes: Single leading label column (L=1); the first data column is position 2 (ETV=2, V997=3, V801=4, V802=5). The right-hand Comment column is position 6 and is treated as a notes column per prompt section 6: it is neither a schedule column nor an activity, so no schedule_grid or activity_schedule entries are emitted for position 6 and each non-empty Comment cell becomes a footnote annotation. table_type=track and track_label are taken as given from the boundary agent's structure and agree with my own reading: the four encounter columns (ETV, V997, V801, V802) exist in no other table, the table is the shared destination for participants leaving Tables 1-3, and it is not finer-grained timing for a single existing activity, so it is neither domain nor subsidiary. Column boundaries and row bands were recovered from the 200 dpi raster (vertical rules at 71.8 / 292.3 / 330.7 / 365.8 / 413.6 / 466.6 / 737.8 pt); row bands were read from the Comment column, never from the redacted label cells. The text layer of document pages 43-45 is glyph-spread (one glyph per token), so every activity name and annotation text on those pages was rebuilt by word re-segmentation and then checked character-for-character (whitespace removed) against the raw glyph stream; document page 46 has a clean text layer and supplied the verbatim wording of the repeated header block. Rows 14, 30, 33, 36, 41 and 42 are redacted: the activity label is covered by a black bar carrying the red label 'CCI'. They are transcribed as printed ('CCI') and still carry their marks; no attempt was made to recover the hidden names. Rows 41 and 42 sit under one black bar with the 'CCI' label printed once across the boundary between them; the Comment-column rule lines (y=486.4 / 500.2 / 514.1 pt on document page 45) confirm they are two separate rows, each with its own X at ETV. Row 42's label cell carries no text layer at all, so its cell_text is empty and the name was read visually from the shared bar. Rows 6-9 (Concomitant medications, Adverse events, Review modified Mayo score (MMS), Tobacco use) precede the first shaded section header and therefore have no parent; they are given indentation_level 1 like every other mark-carrying row, because level 0 is reserved here for the shaded/bold organizational rows that carry no marks. Indentation is signalled by grey shading and bold rather than by leading whitespace, hence indentation_method=font_signal throughout. No merged marks, spanning arrows or vertically merged marks occur in this table; every mark is a single 'X' in a single column. The abbreviations block on document page 46 yields no annotations: none of its terms is printed as a marker on a grid cell, a header cell or an activity label (section 6).

schedule_properties.property_comment: Visit / encounter identifiers for this table: ETV (early termination visit), V997 (unscheduled visit), V801 and V802 (post-treatment follow-up visits). Named encounters, so property_type=visit; topmost header row, so level 1.

Timing of each encounter expressed in weeks from randomization: em-dash for ETV and V997 (no fixed week), '58 or ETV + 8 weeks after last dose' for V801 and '66 or ETV + 16 weeks after last dose' for V802. Week-numbered timing, so property_type=week.

Protocol study day per encounter; printed as an em-dash in all four columns (no study day is defined for these encounters). Day numbering, so property_type=study_day. Transcribed as printed - the em-dashes are the source content, not missing data.
Allowable visit window in days: em-dash for ETV and V997, +/-7 for V801 and V802. A visit tolerance window, so property_type=window.

Fasting requirement band. The four encounter columns are all empty and the Comment column reads 'No fasting in this period', so this row states a fasting condition rather than distinguishing one column from another; property_type=condition, hierarchical_level null.

annotations.annotation_text: V802 is only for randomized participants who were positive for anti-HBc at screening. All other participants will have their final visit at V801 or ETV.
V997: Additional study procedures can be performed at the discretion of the investigator.

The intervals between ETV and the post-treatment follow-up visit(s) should be adequate to ensure that V801 occurs at least 8 weeks since last dose and V802 (if applicable) occurs at least 16 weeks since last dose.
For AESIs, additional data are collected (Section 8.3.6).
Blood pressure, body temperature, and pulse rate. Vital signs should be measured after participant has been sitting for at least 5 minutes. V997: Vital signs collection is optional.
Fasting is not required for the lipid panel at ETV.

Perform only for women of childbearing potential and women with a history of tubal ligation. At dosing visits which have pregnancy testing, the pregnancy test result must be confirmed to be negative prior to dosing. Pregnancy testing may be performed more frequently than designated on the SoA if local laws or regulations require more frequent testing.
Only for participants who are positive for anti‑HBc at screening.
Collect samples before dosing, if dosing is scheduled. Collect additional samples at specified times relative to onset of hypersensitivity events.
Blood sample for DNA pharmacogenetics can be obtained any time at or after V2.
Recommended at ETV based on judgment of the investigator and after discussion with the sponsor’s medical monitor. If not performed at ETV, this will not be considered a protocol deviation.

Recommended at ETV based on judgment of the investigator and after discussion with the sponsor’s medical monitor. Instructions for collection are provided in the lab manual. Flexible sigmoidoscopy is recommended, except for protocol-specified reasons when a colonoscopy should be performed. If not performed at ETV, this will not be considered a protocol deviation.
No dosing at ETV, V997, or post-treatment follow-up visits.
